title: Parallel-in-iteration optimization using multigrid reduction-in-time
summary: Standard gradient-based iteration algorithms for optimization, such as gradient descent and its various proximal-based extensions to nonsmooth problems, are known to converge slowly for ill-conditioned problems, sometimes requiring many tens of thousands of iterations in practice. Since these iterations are computed sequentially, they may present a computational bottleneck in large-scale parallel simulations.
